en: Black-and-white view of a European city square with a cobblestone street and 1950s–1960s cars. On the right stands a large domed stone building with a cross on top, originally an Ottoman mosque later converted into a church. On the left are ornate historic façades with trees lining the street, and in the background rises a church tower. The back side contains printed multilingual text identifying the location, handwritten Hungarian message and address, a Hungarian stamp and postmark.
